heading: Duration of military protective orders
lead: A military protective order issued by a military commander shall remain in effect until such time as the military commander terminates the order or issues a replacement order.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2009—Pub. L. 111–84 made technical amendment to section catchline.
